card.name: Words that lead into 'day' or 'daily'
card.fires_on: Words and word parts just before a day-length time word, such as 'day', 'dose' or '24 hours', in dosing schedules, and sometimes in narrative text about a day.

modes.label: Dose and day schedules
modes.description: Part of a phrase meaning single dose, once a day, or 24 hours.

modes.label: The day of an event
modes.description: The word 'day' or 'of' in phrases about a particular day.
modes.example: continued on the day<< of>> surgery
